content: Let us not pray to be sheltered from dangers, but to be fearless when facing them.
author: Rabindranath Tagore
explanation:
In this profound teaching from Gitanjali (Fruit-Gathering), Rabindranath Tagore cuts through superficial illusion to reveal a foundational truth of human character. When we operate from fear, distraction, or narrow self-interest, our potential remains fragmented and fragile. By anchoring attention in courage, we awaken an unshakeable clarity that transforms how we navigate hardship and purpose.

True wisdom is never an abstract academic debate; it is an active discipline forged in the quiet arena of daily choices. When your internal conviction matches your outward conduct, the entire trajectory of your life shifts toward lasting strength and peace.
practicalInsight: Take deliberate ownership of your courage today. Strip away trivial distractions and act with steady, uncompromising integrity.
reflectionPrompt: How can you apply greater courage to the primary challenge facing your life right now?
